Summary: Boldness is the Spirit-given courage to speak and act for Christ even when it costs something. The early church prayed not for safety but for boldness, and Peter and John, once fearful, spoke openly before the very council that had condemned Jesus. Christian boldness is never arrogance; it pairs truth with love and rests on the conviction that God is with His people.
RelatedPeople: Simon Peter; John the Apostle; Paul
